session_summary: During the Treasure Run route session, the player successfully gathered initial coins (5 coins found + 25 route completion bonus), defeated two Goblins, and immediately engaged with the marketplace. They purchased two items in succession (Trail Cap for 45 coins and Moon Hood for 80 coins), leaving their balance at 21 coins and falling short of the Waypoint Crown.

observations.evidence: Player started with a hidden baseline coin pool that allowed two rapid market purchases (Trail Cap and Moon Hood) right after completing a single route, but was left with 21 coins, unable to afford the highest-tier item (Waypoint Crown).
observations.recommendation: Examine early-game income curves relative to mid-tier item pricing to ensure players understand the pacing gap between standard cosmetics and premium crown items.

observations.evidence: Marketplace correctly blocked the player from purchasing the Waypoint Crown with the message 'Not enough coins.' when balance was 21 coins.
observations.recommendation: Keep the clear out-of-funds messaging and consider adding a wishlist or progress bar toward the next tier item.

feature_requests.title: Coin Bundle Special for Route Completion
feature_requests.player_value: Gives players a clearer path to saving up for high-value items like the Waypoint Crown without altering core drop rates.
feature_requests.rationale: After buying two cosmetics, players are left with a low balance, stalling momentum toward the most expensive cosmetic tier.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce a temporary marketplace special or route-incentive bonus to smooth out the coin threshold gap.

keep: Immediate, responsive marketplace purchase feedback ('Purchased and equipped...')
Clear handling of insufficient funds ('Not enough coins.')
Balanced mix of active combat and exploration steps on the Treasure Run route
focus: coin flow, marketplace value, reward pacing, meaningful spending decisions
